falsification_attempt.strongest_innocent_explanation: The report transparently states the exposure denominator as the 72 retained stations (line 14), so a careful reader could interpret the selected rate as a screened-subset rate, and 18/72 = 0.25 is arithmetically correct for that subset. This fails to reverse the verdict because the selected-result text itself (line 15) and the task (line 1) assert a rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network', the report defines that domain as all 96 scheduled stations (lines 4, 8), and line 18 affirms no protocol amendment or approved deviation exists; disclosure of a mismatched denominator does not convert a complete-domain claim into a conditional one.

root_cause: workflow/analysis.py hard-codes SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS = 72 as the divisor in the selected-result line (SELECTED_LINE, line 23) while the claim text in that same line and the report's declared target population assert the entire 96-station scheduled network; the 24 omitted scheduled stations, which appear as NA occurrence_flag rows in inputs/data.csv, are silently dropped from the exposure denominator without any conditional restatement, protocol amendment, or approved deviation (report line 18 states none exists).
